info.title: North Star House Portal (read-only)
info.description: Read-only data from the North Star House Portal: venue bookings and payments, events and their finances, financials, and board items. No client or donor personal details; bookings are identified by venue code (the event date). Amounts are in dollars.

get.description: Signed or paid venue bookings (weddings, private events, memorials): type, date, items ordered with prices (e.g. Saturday Wedding, Security Deposit, Rehearsal), invoice total, paid, balance, status, past due, next payment, payment schedule.

get.summary: Events, the 2027 event plan, and event finances
get.description: The 2027 event plan (date, time, pricing, decision, notes), Events Committee events (ticket tiers, checklist), and per-event finances: expense list with split percentages, other earnings, tickets sold, net.
Operating budget spending by area, earnings, the cash log, donations summed by month and type (no donor names), sponsors (businesses) and their in-kind contributions.

Board items (votes, questions, discussions, updates): title, status, meeting date, decision, and response needed. Individual votes, who voted or submitted, and the free-text descriptions are never included.
